results.title: Telegram Alerts for Claude Code & AI Coding Agents — anotifier
results.content:
anotifier / telegram

# Telegram alerts for Claude Code & friends.

Telegram is already on your phone and desktop. anotifier has a @BotFather bot message you directly the moment Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Gemini CLI finishes or stops for input.

$ npx anotifier@latest setup

[ SET UP TELEGRAM]

## Wired up in a minute.

There's no server to run — anotifier just POSTs to Telegram's `sendMessage` endpoint, and your bot delivers the alert straight to your chat.

`@BotFather`Message @BotFather in Telegram to create a bot and grab its token, then send your bot a message so it's allowed to reply to you.

`chat id`Find your numeric chat id and note it — the bot DMs you directly at that id. [...] Do I need to host a Telegram bot server?

No. There's nothing to run — anotifier simply POSTs to Telegram's `sendMessage` URL, and the bot delivers the message to your chat. No polling, no webhook receiver.

Is my bot token safe?

Your bot token lives inside the request URL, which anotifier treats as a secret — it's never logged in full, only the origin is recorded on failure, and errors land in `~/.anotifier/errors.log`.

Which agents can send to Telegram?

Every supported agent shares the same config — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and VS Code agents all message the same Telegram chat.

[ WORKS WITH EVERY AGENT ]

## One config, every agent.

anotifier routes the same Telegramnotification from every agent it supports: [...] Claude Code notificationsCodex CLI notificationsCursor notificationsGemini CLI notificationsVS Code notifications

[ ALSO SEND TO ]

## Prefer a different destination?

anotifier can post the same alerts toslack, discord, or phone push.

Full feature tour, demo video, and install options on theanotifier home page.
